goal: Build the Tahoe Dock and a registry that maps apps to their icons and window contents.
summary: Phase 3 completed: AppRegistry and Dock are built and wired. The registry maps 8 core apps to icons and placeholder components; Dock renders them with Liquid Glass styling, tooltips, running indicators, and minimized-windows area; clicks open, focus, or restore windows through the window manager store. Unit tests (34 passed) and e2e tests (9 passed) verify the behavior, and the production build succeeds. Evidence includes a git diff patch and a dock screenshot.
stepSummaries:
1. Create AppRegistry with metadata for the eight core apps plus generic app icon assets. [verified]
  2. Build Dock component with app icons, hover tooltips, running indicators, and minimized windows area. [verified]
  3. Wire Dock clicks to open/restore windows via the window manager store. [verified]
